## D — Accuracy notes and source flags: alcohol, other drugs and driving
Every C and C2 fact cites exactly one physical manual page from the selected range; nothing relies on outside knowledge.
The whole manual carries an old content-currency date (stated in part A), so any rule here may have changed since; the freshness debt in part A covers every fact in this section.
The share of test questions on this topic is worded three ways: at least a quarter by law on the chapter's first page, a flat quarter in the sample-question note, and roughly a quarter on the exam page; the at-least wording is taught and the others are recorded (verify TN-ALC-D-SHARE) [A01].
The BAC effects table and the DUI penalty table came out of the PDF as separated columns; the penalty rows were rebuilt in column order and taught for the first, second and fourth convictions, while the drinks-per-BAC table was not taught (verify TN-ALC-D-TABLE) [A04].
The ignition interlock paragraph is printed as a broken sentence that never says what the device restriction applies to, so its first, second and third offense durations are not taught; only the two-DUI six-month rule is taught (verify TN-ALC-D-INTERLOCK) [A04].
Vehicle seizure appears in two forms: the text says seizure follows two DUI convictions within five years when both came after a stated cutoff date, while the penalty table marks every second or later conviction as subject to seizure; the text version is taught (verify TN-ALC-D-SEIZURE) [A04].
The yearly fatality figures are dated statistics and the Redline phone number is a contact detail; both are flagged as dynamic [A06].

corpus_stability.reason: The Tennessee Comprehensive Driver License Manual says its content is current as of July 1, 2022 and its back cover carries one March 2025 print authorization; nothing in the selected pages suggests more than one rewrite per year, but the content date is old, so freshness is held as debt rather than assumed.

verification_debt.claim_text: Physical page 93 says by law at least a quarter of knowledge test questions cover drugs and alcohol, physical page 98 says a quarter of questions come from this chapter, and physical page 35 says roughly a quarter; confirm the current test blueprint from an official source.

The DUI penalty table and the BAC effects table on physical pages 94 and 96 extracted as separated columns; the penalty rows were rebuilt in column order and the drinks-per-BAC rows were not taught; confirm current penalties from an official Tennessee source.

Physical page 96 gives interlock restriction periods by offense in a sentence missing its subject; confirm the current ignition interlock requirements for first, second and third offenses from an official Tennessee source.

Physical page 96 text ties seizure to two DUI convictions within five years with both after January 1997, while the penalty table on the same page marks every second or later conviction as subject to seizure and forfeiture; confirm the current seizure rule.
